title: Westworld - Consciousness does not exist, Anthony Hopkins
summary: A two-minute Westworld scene in which Robert Ford and Bernard Lowe discuss whether consciousness exists. Ford argues that the self is a fiction for hosts and humans alike.
why: HN uses it in AI and consciousness debates as a memorable take on why general intelligence is hard to define.

quote.text: westworld (yes the tv-series) has the best explanation of why general intelligence is a hard problem to solve.
